description: Switch a project's Jira connection on or off, keeping its token — and, with 'confluence', whether the same site's Confluence is read too. Off, nothing reads that Jira or writes to it — the issue screen, the agents, the status sync — and issues keep their keys there. Switched on, the held token is asked of the site first and refused with the site's reason if it no longer opens it. Connecting a Jira, or giving a new token — Confluence's own included — is done on the board's Jira sheet (get_jira_connection's 'url'), never here. For whoever administers the project.

confluence.description: true to read the same site's Confluence too, false to stop. Leave out to keep it as it is.

enabled.description: true to switch the connection on, false to switch it off. Leave out to keep it as it is.

name: set_jira_connection
title: Set Jira connection
